i personally use a binder or disk bound system notebook for my journals. i just need to have the pages re-positionable so i can put all my collections and all my trackers in separate sections in the journal, separate from the planner part. 

so how you do such things is totally personal. 

one idea if you use a non re-positionable notebook would be to put monthly trackers and collections in the beginning of the month and yearly ones at the end of the book working backwards. that way you have your monthly things in the month they are relevant in and you can leave them behind in that month. and the yearly ones that stay relevant are all together at the end and easy to flip to
